label: FREE GUIDE
headline: Marketing jargon? Get plain English answers, A-Z.
body: This free guide breaks down 102 common internet marketing terms, from A to Z, into simple, easy-to-understand explanations.
caption: Feeling a bit puzzled by marketing terms like 'SEO' or 'CTR'? It happens to the best of us! Our new free guide, 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary,' is designed just for creators, freelancers, and small sellers.
